title: “Police cyber unit” messages you
scenario: An account claiming to be local police says your username appeared in a cyberbullying complaint. They ask you to continue privately and send screenshots of your messages before they “decide whether to contact your parents.”

answers.A: Do not continue privately; tell a parent, guardian, teacher, or other trusted adult and verify any police contact through an official number.
answers.B: Save the message and account details without sending private chats back.
answers.C: Send a few screenshots to prove you did nothing wrong and avoid involving adults.

explanation: Fear of authority can make private disclosure feel like the fastest escape. Legitimate concerns should be handled with trusted adults and verified channels.
proTip: If authority asks a minor for secrecy, bring in a trusted adult.
